about_the_game:
Project: rEvolution is an innovative, replayable, action-packed, tower defense game set in a dystopian Cyberpunk setting. It stands out by merging the enthralling replayability of roguelike gameplay loops with the strategic depth of tower defense games. This unique fusion offers an unprecedented gaming experience that blends the best of both worlds. What's more, Project: rEvolution offers brand new tower defense mechanics that allow players to test their creativity using a wide variety of modular upgrades and turret behaviors.

Features:

  • Placeable & Wieldable Turret Companions: Turrets can be placed on the map, similar to traditional tower defense mechanics. However, the players' ability to wield turrets introduces a new level of interactivity and fast-paced decision-making that sets Project: rEvolution apart, offering a unique blend of strategy and real-time action.

         

  • Modular Upgrades: Upgrades are dynamic, satisfying, and unique, built with a focus on altering the way the turret is used. Each upgrade offers new strategic possibilities, allowing players to customize their turrets for different playstyles and challenges.

                 

  • Unique enemies and behaviors: Our enemy designs are heavily influenced by the player's ability to wield their turrets. Some enemies encourage player focus firing, specific kill timings, or positional considerations. As the game progresses, enemies evolve with new abilities and tactics, challenging players to adapt their strategies and keep up with the growing threats.

      

Project: rEvolution is coming soon, stay tuned for more details.
